info.name: Argus Enterprise Core Authentication Subscriptions API

items.docs: Retrieve all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated account, including their status and configured event types.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Create a Webhook Subscription

items.docs: Create a new webhook subscription to receive real-time notifications for specified event types. The target URL must be HTTPS and will receive a verification request before activation.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Get a Webhook Subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific webhook subscription.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Update a Webhook Subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Update the configuration of an existing webhook subscription.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Delete a Webhook Subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Permanently delete a webhook subscription. No further events will be delivered to the configured URL.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Pause a Webhook Subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Temporarily pause a webhook subscription. Events will be queued and can be replayed when the subscription is resumed.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Resume a Webhook Subscription

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Resume a paused webhook subscription. Any queued events will be delivered to the configured URL.

info.name: Argus Enterprise Send a Test Event

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Unique identifier of the webhook subscription

items.docs: Send a test webhook event to the subscription endpoint to verify connectivity and payload handling.
